scenes.title: 卧室·起床
scenes.description: 从睁开眼睛开始，认识卧室里的物品与早晨的动作。

words.en: get out on the wrong side of the bed

sentences.en: My roommate often leaves the table lamp on all night long.
sentences.zh: 我的室友经常一整夜都开着台灯。

sentences.en: I didn't know the alarm clock went off.
sentences.zh: 我不知道闹钟响过了。

sentences.en: My sister doesn't seem happy.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐看起来不太高兴。

sentences.en: She must have gotten out on the wrong side of the bed.
sentences.zh: 她肯定一起床就心情不好。

sentences.en: I stretched and yawned before getting out of bed, but I still felt sleepy.
sentences.zh: 起床之前，我伸了伸懒腰，打了个哈欠，可还是很困。

sentences.en: I looked out the window rubbing my drowsy eyes.
sentences.zh: 我揉着惺忪的睡眼，看着窗外。

sentences.en: I have a stiff neck.
sentences.zh: 我落枕了。

sentences.en: I might have slept wrong.
sentences.zh: 可能是因为睡姿不对。

sentences.en: I have sore muscles.
sentences.zh: 我肌肉酸痛。

sentences.en: I should not have played tennis for so many hours yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天不该打那么长时间的网球。

sentences.en: Ugh.
sentences.zh: 呃。

sentences.en: I have a bad hangover.
sentences.zh: 我宿醉得很厉害。

sentences.en: I have to be careful not to drink too much.
sentences.zh: 我应该小心点，不能喝那么多酒。

sentences.en: Oh, I've overslept!
sentences.zh: 哎呀，我睡过头了！

sentences.en: Not again.
sentences.zh: 怎么又是这样。

sentences.en: It's time to get up!
sentences.zh: 该起床了！

sentences.en: Fold up your comforter and put it in the closet.
sentences.zh: 把被子叠起来，放到衣橱里面。

sentences.en: I turn on the TV and watch the weather report every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都会打开电视看天气预报。

sentences.en: There are some suits hanging in the closet.
sentences.zh: 衣橱里挂着几件西服。

sentences.en: Take out your socks from the chest and put them on.
sentences.zh: 从柜子里面把你的袜子拿出来穿上。

sentences.en: Do you think this tie goes with this dress shirt?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这条领带跟这件白衬衫相配吗？

sentences.en: Will you help me zip up my dress?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我拉上连衣裙的拉链吗？

sentences.en: Good morning, Tom.
sentences.zh: 早上好，汤姆。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Did you have a good night's sleep?
sentences.zh: 昨晚睡得好吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I heard you go downstairs last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚听到你下楼了。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Oh, no, actually, I didn't sleep well.
sentences.zh: 唉，实际上我睡得并不好。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I drank too much at the party last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚的聚会上，我喝了太多酒。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I felt sick and went to the bathroom in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 半夜感觉不舒服，所以去了洗手间。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: That's too bad.
sentences.zh: 真可怜。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Are you OK now?
sentences.zh: 你现在好些了吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Except for a terrible hangover.
sentences.zh: 还是宿醉得厉害。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Why don't you take stomach medicine?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不吃点胃药呢？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Yeah, I will.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我得吃点。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Where is the medicine chest?
sentences.zh: 药箱在哪儿呢？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: In the closet in our bedroom.
sentences.zh: 在我们卧室的衣橱里面。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
sentences.speaker: Tom

scenes.title: 盥洗室·仪容
scenes.description: 学习洗漱、护肤和整理仪容的生活英语。

words.en: look at oneself in a mirror

sentences.en: May I use your bathroom?
sentences.zh: 我能用一下你的洗手间吗？

sentences.en: I turned on the faucet and filled the washbowl with hot water.
sentences.zh: 我打开水龙头，在洗脸盆里放了热水。

sentences.en: I squeezed out some toothpaste on the toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 我把一些牙膏挤到了牙刷上。

sentences.en: Gargle when you get home so you won't catch a cold.
sentences.zh: 到家之后要漱口，这样就不会感冒了。

sentences.en: My face is swollen after sleeping 12 hours straight.
sentences.zh: 我连着睡了12个小时，脸都肿了。

sentences.en: Gee, I dropped my contact lens on the floor.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我的隐形眼镜掉地上了。

sentences.en: You have a pimple on your right cheek.
sentences.zh: 你的右脸颊上长了个粉刺。

sentences.en: Don't pick at it.
sentences.zh: 别用手抓它。

sentences.en: This electric shaver doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 电动剃须刀不转了。

sentences.en: It needs recharging.
sentences.zh: 该给它充电了。

sentences.en: My father looks younger after shaving his mustache.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸刮了胡子之后看起来更年轻了。

sentences.en: My boyfriend doesn't like women who spray on strong perfume.
sentences.zh: 我男朋友不喜欢女士喷太浓的香水。

sentences.en: Don't I look different after penciling my eyebrows?
sentences.zh: 描完眉毛之后，我看起来没有变化吗？

sentences.en: Why don't you comb your hair?
sentences.zh: 你怎么不梳梳头发？

sentences.en: It's messy.
sentences.zh: 乱糟糟的。

sentences.en: It usually takes 10 minutes to blow-dry my hair.
sentences.zh: 我的头发用吹风机吹干通常得十分钟。

sentences.en: Dad!
sentences.zh: 爸爸！

sentences.en: Put the toilet seat back down after using it.
sentences.zh: 上完厕所把马桶座圈放回去。

sentences.en: The toilet doesn't flush.
sentences.zh: 马桶不冲水了。

sentences.en: It's probably clogged.
sentences.zh: 可能是堵了。

sentences.en: Is someone in here?
sentences.zh: 里面有人吗？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Yeah, daddy.
sentences.zh: 有人，爸爸。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: I'm drying off so don't even try to open the door.
sentences.zh: 我在擦身子呢，千万别开门。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: Oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: How long will it take?
sentences.zh: 你得要多长时间？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Well, maybe 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大概得30分钟。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: 30 minutes?
sentences.zh: 30分钟？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Why so long?
sentences.zh: 为什么要那么长时间？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: I have a big date today and I need to style my hair and put on makeup.
sentences.zh: 我今天有个很重要的约会，所以我得给头发做造型，还得化妆。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: A big date?
sentences.zh: 重要约会？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: You're too young.
sentences.zh: 你还太小了。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Anyway, I want to use the toilet.
sentences.zh: 总之，我得用洗手间。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Get out right now!!
sentences.zh: 马上给我出来！
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: OK, OK.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: I'm coming.
sentences.zh: 来了。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: Wait a minute!
sentences.zh: 等一小会儿！
sentences.speaker: Lucy

scenes.title: 餐桌·早餐
scenes.description: 认识早餐食物、餐具与用餐表达。

words.zh: 小麦面包;精白面粉和全麦粗粉混合做成的面包

words.en: put / spread butter on the bread

words.zh: 挑食的人,吃饭挑剔的人
无咖啡因咖啡:低卡咖啡

sentences.en: Mother, I'll fix you breakfast if you don't feel well.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，如果您身体不舒服，我来替您准备早餐吧。

sentences.en: You should not skip breakfast even if you go on a diet.
sentences.zh: 虽然你在减肥但你也不能不吃早餐。

sentences.en: Do they serve a continental or English breakfast at the hotel?
sentences.zh: 酒店提供的是欧式早餐还是英式早餐？

sentences.en: Will you pass me the salt shaker?
sentences.zh: 能把盐瓶递给我吗？

sentences.en: Why don't you put butter on your bread?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不在面包上抹点黄油呢？

sentences.en: It would taste better that way.
sentences.zh: 那样味道会更好。

sentences.en: Which do you like, omelets or fried eggs?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪一种，煎蛋卷还是煎鸡蛋？

sentences.en: I can't eat this soup.
sentences.zh: 我喝不来这种汤。

sentences.en: It's a little too hot.
sentences.zh: 有点太辣了。

sentences.en: I don't like fermented soybeans.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢豆酱。

sentences.en: The smell is awful.
sentences.zh: 太难闻了。

sentences.en: Wow, these bacon and eggs are very spicy.
sentences.zh: 哇，这些咸肉煎蛋太辣了。

sentences.en: Can I get water, please?
sentences.zh: 能给我点水吗？

sentences.en: Mmm, I love the aroma of this coffee.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢这种咖啡的香味。

sentences.en: What would you like to have as a breakfast beverage?
sentences.zh: 早餐你想喝什么饮料？

sentences.en: Can I have a decaf coffee?
sentences.zh: 我能要一杯无咖啡因咖啡吗？

sentences.en: I often can't sleep after drinking regular coffee.
sentences.zh: 喝完普通咖啡后，我经常睡不着。

sentences.en: You should roll up your sleeves before washing dishes.
sentences.zh: 洗碗之前，你应该卷起袖子。

sentences.en: Use a scouring brush and dish detergent for grease on the pan.
sentences.zh: 用擦洗用的刷子和餐具洗涤剂清洗锅上的油污。

sentences.en: After I wash the dishes, will you dry them with the dishcloth?
sentences.zh: 我洗完餐具之后，你能用洗碗布把它们擦干吗？

sentences.en: Breakfast is ready.
sentences.zh: 早餐准备好了。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Come sit down.
sentences.zh: 过来坐吧。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Morning, mom.
sentences.zh: 早上好，妈妈。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: It looks tasty but I'm not hungry right now.
sentences.zh: 早餐看起来真的很美味，但我现在一点都不饿。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Well, you should eat breakfast.
sentences.zh: 你得吃早饭。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Only a little bite.
sentences.zh: 只吃一点也行。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好吧。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: I'll eat just a little cereal and… what's this?
sentences.zh: 我就喝一点麦片粥和……这是什么？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: It's vegetable soup.
sentences.zh: 是蔬菜汤。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: You can eat it.
sentences.zh: 你可以喝。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Yeah, I'll have this, too.
sentences.zh: 好，我也要喝点蔬菜汤。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Can you pour milk in my cereal?
sentences.zh: 你能往我的麦片粥里倒些牛奶吗？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: I'll make coffee, would you like some?
sentences.zh: 我要煮咖啡，你要喝点吗？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: No thanks.
sentences.zh: 不了，谢谢。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Strong coffee is not good for my stomach.
sentences.zh: 浓咖啡对我的胃没有好处。
sentences.speaker: Mike

scenes.title: 门厅·院子
scenes.description: 从门厅走到院子，练习出门前后的表达。

words.zh: 公寓(套房私有,其他地方属业主共有);一套公寓住房
低跟轻便舞鞋;(打网球时穿的)橡胶底浅口帆布鞋
牛津鞋(一种系带浅口鞋)
无意中遇到/碰到/ 撞到⋯

words.en: water the garden with a hose

sentences.en: Pochi is upstairs.
sentences.zh: 波基在楼上。

sentences.en: Go and get him.
sentences.zh: 去叫他吧。

sentences.en: My apartment is a 15-minute walk from the station.
sentences.zh: 我的公寓离车站步行需要15分钟。

sentences.en: I've been thinking about buying a condominium.
sentences.zh: 我一直在考虑买一套公寓。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: My apartment is made with reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 我住的公寓是钢筋混凝土结构。

sentences.en: Did you lock up the back door?
sentences.zh: 你锁后门了吗？

sentences.en: There're a lot of thieves out there these days.
sentences.zh: 最近附近小偷很多。

sentences.en: I prefer loafers to oxfords.
sentences.zh: 比起牛津鞋，我更喜欢平跟船鞋。

sentences.en: Loafers are easier to put on.
sentences.zh: 平跟船鞋更容易穿上。

sentences.en: Usually I wear flats when I go shopping.
sentences.zh: 我去逛街的时候，通常穿平跟鞋。

sentences.en: The shoehorn is beside the shoe cabinet.
sentences.zh: 鞋拔子在鞋柜旁边。

sentences.en: Use it if you like.
sentences.zh: 想用就用吧。

sentences.en: Don't put up your umbrella while riding a bike.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车的时候别把伞撑开。

sentences.en: It's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 那样做很危险的。

sentences.en: Look who it is through the peephole before opening the door.
sentences.zh: 开门之前，先透过窥视孔看看外面是谁。

sentences.en: Rushing out of my apartment, I bumped into the super.
sentences.zh: 我急匆匆冲出公寓，结果撞到了公寓管理员。

sentences.en: Will you take Pochi out for a walk?
sentences.zh: 你能带波基出去散散步吗？

sentences.en: I said hello to my neighbor over the hedge this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我隔着篱笆向邻居问好。

sentences.en: I have 20 tropical fish in a tank in the living room.
sentences.zh: 我在起居室的鱼缸里养了20条热带鱼。

sentences.en: Look!
sentences.zh: 快看！

sentences.en: The morning glories in the flowerpots are budding.
sentences.zh: 花盆里的牵牛花开始长花苞了。

sentences.en: I'm late for school!
sentences.zh: 我上学要迟到了！
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: I have to hurry.
sentences.zh: 我得快一点了。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Don't run down the stairs, Mike.
sentences.zh: 不要跑着下楼，迈克。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Yes, mom.
sentences.zh: 好的，妈妈。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: How's the weather today?
sentences.zh: 今天天气怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: It's raining a little, so carry your umbrella with you.
sentences.zh: 正在下小雨，所以把你的伞带上。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: But I think a raincoat would be better because I'm going to school by bike today.
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得穿雨衣可能更好，因为我今天要骑自行车去学校。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 说得对。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Putting up an umbrella while riding a bike is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 在骑自行车的时候打伞是很危险的。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: What about rain boots?
sentences.zh: 要穿雨鞋吗？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: No, thank you.
sentences.zh: 不用了，谢谢妈妈。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Sneakers are fine.
sentences.zh: 穿运动鞋就行了。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: You should get up earlier so you don't have to rush out of the house tomorrow, Mike.
sentences.zh: 不过，你明天应该早点起床，这样也就不必急匆匆地出门了，迈克。
sentences.speaker: Kate

scenes.description: 在车站、地铁和公交上使用英语。

words.zh: 公用电话亭;报刊亭;小亭

words.en: buy a newspaper at the newsstand

换乘证；转车票；联运车票
(尤指可使用原车票继续坐车的)中途停留

words.en: make it to / catch the train
put one's bag on the rack

sentences.en: Wait at the west exit.
sentences.zh: 在西出口等我。

sentences.en: I'll pick you up.
sentences.zh: 我会去接你。

sentences.en: I sometimes buy a sports paper at that kiosk.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我会在那个报刊亭买份体育报纸。

sentences.en: Let's check the timetable to see how often trains come.
sentences.zh: 我们去查查行车时刻表，看看火车多久来一趟。

sentences.en: Oops!
sentences.zh: 哎呀！

sentences.en: I got stopped by the turnstile.
sentences.zh: 我被验票闸门挡住了。

sentences.en: This pass has expired.
sentences.zh: 这张月票已经过期了。

sentences.en: How much is the fare to Fifth Avenue?
sentences.zh: 到第五大道的车费是多少？

sentences.en: Wait, I need to adjust fares before passing through the turnstile.
sentences.zh: 等一下，我得先补票才能通过验票闸门。

sentences.en: Sit here.
sentences.zh: 坐在这儿吧。

sentences.en: I'm getting off at the next stop.
sentences.zh: 我在下一站就下车了。

sentences.en: We had better switch to a rapid train at the next station.
sentences.zh: 我们最好在下一站换乘一列快车。

sentences.en: I'm tired of getting crushed on the train every morning.
sentences.zh: 每天早上坐火车都被挤来挤去，我受够了。

sentences.en: Someone stepped on my foot but I didn't see who it was.
sentences.zh: 有人踩到我的脚了，但我没看到踩我的人到底是谁。

sentences.en: Oh, no!
sentences.zh: 呀，不好！

sentences.en: That guy is trying to molest a woman.
sentences.zh: 那个家伙正在试图对一位女士进行性骚扰。

sentences.en: I sometimes sleep past my station when I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 有时候我太累了，就睡过站了。

sentences.en: What time does the last train leave?
sentences.zh: 末班车什么时间发车？

sentences.en: Every bus starts from the depot over there.
sentences.zh: 每辆公交车都从那边的公共汽车站发车。

sentences.en: Do you know how to get to the Central Hospital?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎么去中心医院吗？
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 知道。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: First, we'll take an express train to Eastbridge, and change to the Orange Line there.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们得坐特快列车到东桥站，然后在那里换乘橙色线。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: And after that?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: When we arrive at Northend, we'll take a municipal bus the rest of the way.
sentences.zh: 到达诺森德后，剩下的路就得坐城市公交车了。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: And how long will it take?
sentences.zh: 全程得花多长时间呢？
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: Usually it takes about 35 minutes, but today is Sunday, so we'll have to allow at least 50 minutes.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，大约35分钟，但今天是星期天，所以，我们可能至少得留出50分钟。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: We have enough time anyway.
sentences.zh: 没关系，我们的时间足够。
sentences.speaker: Lucy

sentences.en: Why don't we get something to eat at that kiosk over there?

sentences.zh: 我不能忍受天天加班！

sentences.zh: 虽然他住在校园内，但有时候，他第一节课还会迟到。

sentences.zh: 我经常看公告栏，看有没有课被取消了。

sentences.zh: 这个学期你选了几门课？

sentences.en: Can you believe it?
sentences.zh: 你能相信吗？

sentences.zh: 根据教学大纲，将根据出勤情况给学生打分。

sentences.zh: 我的专业是心理学。

sentences.zh: 你能帮我决定一下选哪门课吗？

sentences.zh: 他的课要求非常严格，我写了许多篇论文。

sentences.en: Wow, that sounds tough.

sentences.en: I don't want to brag about it, though.

sentences.en: Good for you.

sentences.zh: 不过，我觉得我可能应付不了那门课。

sentences.en: I do the laundry every other day.
sentences.zh: 我每隔一天洗一次衣服。

sentences.en: Load the washing machine with the proper amount of detergent.
sentences.zh: 在洗衣机里倒入适量的洗涤剂。

sentences.en: Add softener when the rinse cycle starts.
sentences.zh: 在漂洗模式开始时，加入柔顺剂。

sentences.en: The water temperature should not be too hot or too cold.
sentences.zh: 水的温度不能太高，也不能太低。

sentences.en: I usually hang out my clothes to dry when it's sunny.
sentences.zh: 晴天的时候，我通常会将衣服挂在外面晾干。

sentences.en: I wash my silk scarves by hand.
sentences.zh: 我手洗我的真丝围巾。

sentences.en: I iron my pants instead of taking them to the drycleaner.
sentences.zh: 我自己熨裤子，而不是把它们送到干洗店。

sentences.en: Don't forget to starch your shirts before you iron them.
sentences.zh: 熨衬衫之前，别忘了上浆。

sentences.en: It's difficult to remove this coffee stain from my sweater.
sentences.zh: 我毛衣上的这片咖啡渍很难弄掉。

sentences.en: My skirt is torn; I have to mend it.
sentences.zh: 我的裙子撕破了；我得把它补好。

sentences.en: Wash your wool cardigan carefully, or it will shrink.
sentences.zh: 洗羊毛衫的时候要小心，否则它会缩水的。

sentences.en: This leather jacket is fake.
sentences.zh: 这件皮夹克是假的。

sentences.en: I like to wear T-shirts and jeans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢穿T恤衫和牛仔裤。

sentences.en: I took off my coat and a pair of gloves before I entered the house.
sentences.zh: 进家门之前，我脱掉了外套，摘下了手套。

sentences.en: I left my purse on the train.
sentences.zh: 我把手袋落在火车上了。

sentences.en: We need to do the laundry.
sentences.zh: 我们得洗衣服了。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: The hamper is full.
sentences.zh: 洗衣筐都满了。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I'll put the clothes in the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 我这就把衣服都放到洗衣机里。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: No, no!
sentences.zh: 别，别！
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Don't put everything in at once!
sentences.zh: 不要一次把所有衣服都放进去！
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: We have to see if we can wash them or not.
sentences.zh: 我们得看看能不能机洗。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Oh, right.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Now, these sweatshirts are made of cotton and are machine washable.
sentences.zh: 这些运动衫都是棉质的，可以机洗。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: But this skirt should be dry-cleaned only, and the same goes for this plaid jacket.
sentences.zh: 但这件裙子只能干洗，这件格子夹克也得干洗。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I'll take them to the drycleaner.
sentences.zh: 我把它们送到干洗店去。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I have to go there anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正我也得去一趟。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I forgot to pick up my winter overcoat.
sentences.zh: 我忘了取我冬天的外套了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: It's been at the drycleaner for almost a year!
sentences.zh: 我忘在干洗店快有一年了！
sentences.speaker: Tom

scenes.title: 厨房·烹饪
scenes.description: 认识食材、厨具和烹饪动作。

words.zh: 微波炉/用微波炉烹调(或加热)食物
打,搅拌(奶油、蛋等)使成糊状(或泡沫状)

words.en: separate an egg into yolk and white
words.zh: 将鸡蛋的蛋黃与蛋清分开

sentences.en: I often use frozen food because it's easy to prepare in a microwave.
sentences.zh: 我经常吃速冻食品，因为用微波炉做很容易。

sentences.en: I put plates and chopsticks on the tray.
sentences.zh: 我把盘子和筷子放在了托盘里。

sentences.en: The lid is hot.
sentences.zh: 盖子很热。

sentences.en: Use an oven mitten to hold it.
sentences.zh: 拿的时候戴上隔热手套。

sentences.en: My father is good at cooking, and so am I.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸很擅长烹饪，我也是。

sentences.en: You have to stir well.
sentences.zh: 你得好好搅拌。

sentences.en: Beat the egg whites with an eggbeater until firm peaks form.
sentences.zh: 用打蛋器打蛋白，直到浓稠发泡为止。

sentences.en: Sprinkle the salt and pepper into the bowl.
sentences.zh: 在碗里撒盐和胡椒粉。

sentences.en: I turned the faucet on and filled the kettle with water.
sentences.zh: 我打开水龙头，在壶里放满了水。

sentences.en: Put the pot on the stove and turn up the flame.
sentences.zh: 把锅放到炉子上，然后开大火。

sentences.en: I was baking some cookies, but I burned them carelessly.
sentences.zh: 我在烤饼干，但不小心烤糊了。

sentences.en: I reheated the leftover stew.
sentences.zh: 我把剩下的炖菜重新加热了一下。

sentences.en: I have to chill the sauce in the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 我得把酱汁放到冰箱里冷却。

sentences.en: The recipe tells you what kinds of ingredients you need.
sentences.zh: 菜谱会告诉你需要哪些材料。

sentences.en: I took a frozen pizza out of the freezer.
sentences.zh: 我从冰箱里取出一份冷冻比萨。

sentences.en: Can you measure two tablespoons of sugar?
sentences.zh: 你能量出两大汤匙糖吗？

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: I'm making some sandwiches and a salad for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我在准备午餐吃的三明治和一份沙拉。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Can you give me a hand?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我吗？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然了。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: What can I do?
sentences.zh: 需要我做什么？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Will you peel these carrots and slice them?
sentences.zh: 你能把这些胡萝卜去皮，然后切成薄片吗？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 没问题。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: What's in the pan?
sentences.zh: 锅里是什么？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: I'm boiling some eggs.
sentences.zh: 我在煮鸡蛋。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: I'll chop them and then mix them with mayonnaise and mustard to make sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 我会把它们剁碎，然后混上蛋黄酱和芥末，来做三明治。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Sounds delicious.
sentences.zh: 听起来很好吃。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Shall I make dressing for the salad?
sentences.zh: 我来给沙拉调味好吗？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Yes, please.
sentences.zh: 当然。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Here's the recipe.
sentences.zh: 这是菜谱。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: You can find oil and vinegar on the counter.
sentences.zh: 油和醋就在台面上。
sentences.speaker: Kate

scenes.title: 购物·超市
scenes.description: 学习商店、超市和购物交流。

words.zh: (商店、仓库、洞穴、两排树间的)狭长通道,过道
换到另一个收银台排队

sentences.en: May I help you?
sentences.zh: 我可以帮你吗？
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.en: Thank you, but I'm just looking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，我只是随便看看。
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.en: I bought a lot of canned food at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我从食品杂货店买了很多罐装食品。

sentences.en: This skirt is a little long, so I need to alter the length.
sentences.zh: 这条裙子有点长，所以我需要改一下它的长度。

sentences.en: I bought this jacket at a discount.
sentences.zh: 我买这件夹克时有折扣。

sentences.en: That hat was a good buy, but it was not returnable.
sentences.zh: 这顶帽子真划算，只可惜不能退换。

sentences.en: You should check the price tag before you try it on.
sentences.zh: 你在试穿之前应该先看看价格标签。

sentences.en: Excuse me, but where is the fitting room?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，请问试衣间在哪儿？

sentences.en: I went up and down the aisle of the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我在超市的过道里走来走去。

sentences.en: I went up to the cash register.
sentences.zh: 我来到收银台那里。

sentences.en: That register was cash only, so I switched to another line.
sentences.zh: 那个收银台只收现金，所以我换到另外一个收银台排队。

sentences.en: Which do you eat more often, fish or meat?
sentences.zh: 你经常吃什么，鱼还是肉？

sentences.en: Whenever I go to a sushi bar, I always order tuna and squid.
sentences.zh: 每次我去寿司店的时候，都会点金枪鱼和鱿鱼。

sentences.en: I'm looking for canned beverages.
sentences.zh: 我正在找罐装饮料。

sentences.en: Do they contain chemicals?
sentences.zh: 这里面含化学成分吗？

sentences.en: I often browse weeklies at a nearby convenience store.
sentences.zh: 我经常会在附近的便利店随便看看周刊。

sentences.en: How about beef steak and baked potatoes for tonight's dinner?
sentences.zh: 今天晚饭吃牛排和烤土豆怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Hmm… I want something lighter.
sentences.zh: 嗯……我想吃些更清淡的。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Hey, these scallops look fresh and nice!
sentences.zh: 嘿，那些扇贝看起来很新鲜，应该不错！
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: OK, get them.
sentences.zh: 好，那就买吧。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: We need some vegetables, too.
sentences.zh: 我们还得买些蔬菜。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: A bag of string beans and a bunch of asparagus will make good side dishes.
sentences.zh: 一包四季豆和一捆芦笋可以做成很好的配菜。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Let's have some peaches for dessert.
sentences.zh: 我们买点桃子做甜点吧。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: 好主意。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Oh, you get a discount if you have a coupon.
sentences.zh: 对了，如果你有优惠券的话可以享受折扣。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Did you bring it?
sentences.zh: 你带优惠券了吗？
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Of course!
sentences.zh: 当然带了！
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: I always carry coupons with me.
sentences.zh: 我经常随身带着优惠券。
sentences.speaker: Jim

scenes.title: 银行·邮局·医院
scenes.description: 练习银行、邮局和就医场景英语。

words.zh: 落枕；脖子发僵；肩膀酸痛

sentences.en: It's not difficult to operate an ATM.
sentences.zh: 操作ATM 机并不难。

sentences.en: Follow the instructions and press the button.
sentences.zh: 按照说明按键。

sentences.en: I need a personal seal to open a bank account.
sentences.zh: 我需要有个人印章才能开立银行账户。

sentences.en: I deposited all my savings into my bank account.
sentences.zh: 我把所有积蓄都存到银行账户里了。

sentences.en: I will send the letter by express mail.
sentences.zh: 我会用特快专递把信寄出去。

sentences.en: How much does it cost to send air mail?
sentences.zh: 寄航空信要花多少钱？

sentences.en: I wrote a postcard to my friend.
sentences.zh: 我给朋友写了一张明信片。

sentences.en: This letter will be delivered within five days.
sentences.zh: 这封信将在五日内送达。

sentences.en: We need a prescription to buy this drug at a pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 要在药店买这种药，必须得有处方才行。

sentences.en: The nurse took the patient's temperature.
sentences.zh: 护士量了量患者的体温。

sentences.en: I had a toothache, so I went to a dentist.
sentences.zh: 我牙疼，所以去看了牙科医生。

sentences.en: My stiff neck was much better after a good massage.
sentences.zh: 经过好好按摩之后，我的落枕好多了。

sentences.en: I coughed a lot last night and now I have a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 昨晚上我咳嗽得厉害，现在我嗓子疼。

sentences.en: I'm allergic to cat hair.
sentences.zh: 我对猫身上的毛过敏。

sentences.en: Do you have a fever?
sentences.zh: 你发烧吗？

sentences.en: You look awful.
sentences.zh: 你看起来很糟糕。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Are you all right?
sentences.zh: 你还好吧？
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Actually, my stomach hurts terribly.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我胃痛得厉害。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I have no appetite.
sentences.zh: 我没有一点食欲。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I have a headache, too.
sentences.zh: 而且，我还头痛。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: You should go see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 你应该去看医生。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Well, I took some medicine a few minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之前，我刚吃了一些药。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Maybe it's just a cold or bad indigestion.
sentences.zh: 或许，只是感冒或者消化不良吧。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: It can be serious.
sentences.zh: 可能会很严重的。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Come on, go to the hospital now!
sentences.zh: 快点吧，现在就去医院！
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: I have to go to the bank first.
sentences.zh: 我得先去银行。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I don't have cash on hand now.
sentences.zh: 我现在手头没有现金。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: I'll lend you some money.
sentences.zh: 我先借你一些。
sentences.speaker: Jim

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

scenes.title: 休闲·约会
scenes.description: 学习娱乐、运动和约会表达。

words.zh: 变戏法的人;玩杂耍的人
剧本；戏剧；表演；参加（比赛、体育运动等）
(音乐厅、剧场、影院等的)座位划区
戏院、旅馆等入口处的雨篷
再来一个;再演(或唱、奏等)
没有赶上末班列车/公共汽车

sentences.en: We must pay an admission fee at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在入口处买门票。

sentences.en: Can you take a picture of us with this digital camera?
sentences.zh: 你能用这部数码相机给我们拍一张照片吗？

sentences.en: The little boy was lost in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 那个小男孩在人群中走丢了。

sentences.en: The audience applauded the orchestra on stage loudly.
sentences.zh: 观众为舞台上的管弦乐队热烈鼓掌。

sentences.en: This movie is easy to understand and worth watching.
sentences.zh: 这部电影很容易理解，而且值得一看。

sentences.en: This box-office hit is a must-see.
sentences.zh: 这部受欢迎的电影一定要看。

sentences.en: Be sure to see where the emergency exits are.
sentences.zh: 一定要看清楚紧急出口在哪儿。

sentences.en: The athletes are practicing for the finals in the field.
sentences.zh: 运动员们正在操场上为决赛进行训练。

sentences.en: The team I cheered for lost the game.
sentences.zh: 我支持的队伍比赛输了。

sentences.en: The batter hit a home run and his team won the game.
sentences.zh: 击球手打出了本垒打，最后他的队伍贏得了比赛。

sentences.en: I work out at a gym regularly.
sentences.zh: 我定期到体育馆锻炼身体。

sentences.en: At last, he asked me for a date.
sentences.zh: 他终于向我提出约会了。

sentences.en: Former high school classmates got together at a reunion party.
sentences.zh: 以前高中时的同学在一次聚会上再次相聚。

sentences.en: I've heard that John broke up with Britney.
sentences.zh: 我听说约翰与布兰妮分手了。

sentences.en: I went out for dinner with my friend.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友一起出去吃饭了。

sentences.en: What do you think of going to this new amusement park?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们去新开的这家游乐场玩怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I think it will be crowded.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那里肯定人很多。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I hate to wait in long lines.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢排长队等待。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: OK, then.
sentences.zh: 那好吧。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: How about this musical at the ALC Theater?
sentences.zh: 去ALC剧院看这场音乐剧怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I hear it's very popular.
sentences.zh: 我听说这场音乐剧非常受欢迎。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Do you think tickets are still available?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在还能买到票吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Hmm, I don't know…I didn't think about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也不知道⋯⋯我倒没想过这个问题。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: There're no amusing movies this weekend, either.
sentences.zh: 这周末也没有什么有趣的电影。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: They all look boring.
sentences.zh: 上映的电影看起来都很无聊。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: OK, why don't we bring lunch to the park?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们干脆中午到公园野餐怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: It would be nice just to sit on a bench and relax in the sun.
sentences.zh: 坐在长椅上，在阳光下放松心情，应该很不错。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Good idea!
sentences.zh: 好主意！
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: And it's much cheaper, too!
sentences.zh: 而且，这也便宜多了！
sentences.speaker: Lisa

scenes.title: 餐厅·酒吧
scenes.description: 在餐厅和酒吧练习点餐与交流。

words.zh: 路边小饭店；餐车式小餐馆
调味汁瓶;船形调味肉汁盘
墨西哥卷饼;墨西哥炸玉米卷
在这儿吃还是打包带走?

sentences.en: I waited for my girlfriend at a coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 我在咖啡店等我的女朋友。

sentences.en: I stopped at a food stall and got some snacks.
sentences.zh: 我在一家大排档坐了一会儿，吃了些小点心。

sentences.en: Do you have a reservation?
sentences.zh: 您预约了吗？

sentences.en: How many in your party?
sentences.zh: 您一共几位？

sentences.en: The waiter approached our table with menus.
sentences.zh: 服务生拿着菜单来到我们坐的桌子前。

sentences.en: Are you ready to order?
sentences.zh: 您可以点餐了吗？

sentences.en: What's today's special?
sentences.zh: 今天的特色菜是什么？

sentences.en: It's delicious.
sentences.zh: 真好吃。

sentences.en: Can I have seconds?
sentences.zh: 我能再要一份吗？

sentences.en: You can get free refills on soft drinks.
sentences.zh: 软饮料可以免费续杯。

sentences.en: How would you like your steak?
sentences.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟？
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.en: Medium rare, please.
sentences.zh: 要三分熟，谢谢。
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.en: This restaurant is famous for its all-you-can-eat buffet on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅周五的自助餐很有名。

sentences.en: I'd like to propose a toast.
sentences.zh: 我想敬一杯酒。

sentences.en: I got drunk after drinking several cans of beer.
sentences.zh: 我喝了几罐啤酒就醉了。

sentences.en: Can you bring me a straw for my iced tea?
sentences.zh: 能给我拿一根喝冰茶用的吸管吗？

sentences.en: This espresso has a very strong flavor.
sentences.zh: 这种意大利浓咖啡的味道非常浓郁。

sentences.en: The tables seem full.
sentences.zh: 桌子似乎都坐满了。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Did you make a reservation?
sentences.zh: 你预约了吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: No, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 没有。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I guess we have to wait at the bar for a while.
sentences.zh: 我想我们得在吧台那里等一会儿了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Don't drink too much, though.
sentences.zh: 但别喝太多。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: You'll get dizzy if you drink too much on an empty stomach.
sentences.zh: 如果空腹喝太多酒，你会头晕的。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Don't worry, I'll be careful.
sentences.zh: 别担心，我会注意的。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: What would you like to drink?
sentences.zh: 你想喝点什么？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I think I'll have a glass of sparkling wine.
sentences.zh: 我想我还是喝一杯起泡葡萄酒吧。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Me, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Here.
sentences.zh: 给。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Let's make a toast.
sentences.zh: 让我们共同举杯。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Cheers!
sentences.zh: 干杯！
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Oh, looks like our table is ready.
sentences.zh: 啊，我们好像有位子了。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Shall we go?
sentences.zh: 可以去了吗？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Yes, I'm so hungry.
sentences.zh: 当然，我太饿了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I can't wait to eat!
sentences.zh: 等不及了！
sentences.speaker: Tom

scenes.title: 回家·电视·读书
scenes.description: 学习看电视、阅读和居家休闲表达。

words.en: make a phone call to a friend
burn the midnight oil (for an exam)
put a cd into the cd player

words.zh: (戏剧、演出的)上演期;(影片的)连续上映期
清除；使干净；明亮的；纯净的
做动词时,表示“啜泣,发出鸣咽声”

sentences.en: I often rent videos to watch on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我经常租录像带在周末看。

sentences.en: I put my favorite CD into the CD player.
sentences.zh: 我把最爱的CD放到CD机里。

sentences.en: The program wasn't interesting, so I switched to another channel.
sentences.zh: 这个节目没意思，所以我换到了另一个频道。

sentences.en: Turn down the volume; it's too loud.
sentences.zh: 把音量调低一点；太吵了。

sentences.en: The news report was live from the scene.
sentences.zh: 新闻报道是现场直播。

sentences.en: My favorite drama series is on channel 5.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的连续剧在第5频道播放。

sentences.en: The emcee of the quiz program asked the panelist to give his final answer.
sentences.zh: 智力竞赛节目的主持人要求选手给出最终答案。

sentences.en: The storm warning was issued for the area the typhoon was approaching.
sentences.zh: 已向台风正在接近的区域发出暴风雨警报。

sentences.en: The rain has stopped, but it's still cloudy and humid.
sentences.zh: 雨已经停了，但仍然是多云，非常潮湿。

sentences.en: It's difficult to predict when an earthquake will occur.
sentences.zh: 要想预测何时将发生地震是非常困难的。

sentences.en: I skim the newspaper headlines every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都会浏览报纸的头条。

sentences.en: I like to read novels in my free time.
sentences.zh: 我闲暇时喜欢读小说。

sentences.en: Checking e-mail messages on your cell phone can become a habit.
sentences.zh: 通过手机查看电子邮件信息会成为一种习惯。

sentences.en: These days some people cannot live without the Internet.
sentences.zh: 如今，有些人没有互联网根本活不下去。

sentences.en: I spend hours browsing through websites.
sentences.zh: 我花了几个小时浏览网站。

sentences.en: Hi!
sentences.zh: 嗨！
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I'm back!
sentences.zh: 我回来了！
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Oh, hi!
sentences.zh: 哦，嗨！
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I just came home, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是刚刚到家。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Did you check the answering machine?
sentences.zh: 你查看电话留言了吗？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Yeah, but there were no new messages.
sentences.zh: 查过了，不过没有新留言。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Turn on the TV, will you?
sentences.zh: 能打开电视吗？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I have to see the weather forecast for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我得看看明天的天气预报。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: There are no news programs until eleven.
sentences.zh: 在十一点之前没有新闻节目。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Why don't we watch the video we rented yesterday until then?
sentences.zh: 在这之前，我们还是看我们昨天租的录像带吧，你觉得怎么样？
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Yeah, but I will check my e-mail first.
sentences.zh: 好啊，不过我得先查看一下电子邮件。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I can also see tomorrow's weather on the Internet.
sentences.zh: 我也可以从互联网上查看明天的天气情况。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: I'll watch TV for a while.
sentences.zh: 我先看会电视。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

sentences.en: Join me when you're finished.
sentences.zh: 等你查看完了就来跟我一起看吧。
sentences.speaker: Lisa

scenes.title: 洗澡·就寝
scenes.description: 以洗澡、夜间护理和睡前表达结束一天。

words.en: read a book in the bathtub

words.zh: 在体重秤上称自己的重量
把某人的指甲涂成(红色)

words.en: remove the polish from one's nails
words.zh: 去掉某人指甲上的指甲油

words.en: read a fairy tale for kids

sentences.en: I get tired after a day's work.
sentences.zh: 工作了一天，累死我了。

sentences.en: Let's relax a little and take it easy.
sentences.zh: 我们放松一下吧，不着急。

sentences.en: I take a bath every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都洗澡。

sentences.en: I pulled the bath plug and let the water drain out.
sentences.zh: 我拔出浴缸下水塞，让里面的水流干。

sentences.en: I take off my makeup as soon as I come home.
sentences.zh: 我一到家就把妆卸了。

sentences.en: Don't rub your skin too hard.
sentences.zh: 别太用力擦你的皮肤。

sentences.en: I wash my hair with my favorite shampoo.
sentences.zh: 我用最喜欢的洗发水洗头。

sentences.en: I dry myself off with a towel.
sentences.zh: 我用毛巾把全身擦干。

sentences.en: I have to clip my nails.
sentences.zh: 我得剪指甲了。

sentences.en: I weigh myself on the scale after taking a bath.
sentences.zh: 我洗完澡后会在体重秤上称自己的体重。

sentences.en: I set the alarm clock for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我设置了明天的闹钟。

sentences.en: It's time to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 该上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: I was wide awake last night and rolled over many times in bed.
sentences.zh: 昨晚上我非常清醒，在床上翻来覆去睡不着。

sentences.en: You can't tell whether you snore while you are sleeping.
sentences.zh: 你睡着时根本不知道自己是否在打呼噜。

sentences.en: I fell asleep the moment I put my head on the pillow.
sentences.zh: 我脑袋一沾枕头就睡着了。

sentences.en: I'm so exhausted…totally worn out!
sentences.zh: 我太累了⋯⋯精疲力竭了！
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Come here, sit back and relax a little.
sentences.zh: 过来，坐在这儿放松一下。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Thanks, but I'd like to take a hot bath and freshen up.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，但我想洗个热水澡，精神精神。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 去吧。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: The bath is ready.
sentences.zh: 洗澡水都给你准备好了。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Where are my pajamas?
sentences.zh: 我的睡衣在哪儿？
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: They are in the basket, next to the towel rack.
sentences.zh: 在篮子里，靠近毛巾架的地方。
sentences.speaker: Kate

sentences.en: Ah, there they are.
sentences.zh: 哦，找到了。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
sentences.speaker: Mike

sentences.en: Hey, don't fall asleep while you are soaking in the bathtub!
sentences.zh: 嘿，可别在泡澡的时候睡着了。
sentences.speaker: Kate
